newsitem.title: USA: Weakness in US junk bond mart hurts some new deals.
newsitem.headline: Weakness in US junk bond mart hurts some new deals.

text.p: Negative sentiment in the high-yield sector of the U.S. corporate bond market is forcing some issuers to price deals at higher levels than originally anticipated, high-yield sources said.
"When the market gets weak the first thing to get hit is new issues, particularly more agressive deals like zeros and preferreds," said one high yield syndicate source.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc was forced to readjust price talk for ICG Communications and delay the deal by one day, high-yield syndicate sources said.
